title: uiforagents registry item
description: Manifest for one uiforagents component item: a shadcn registry-item dialect superset for a vanilla HTML/CSS kit. Versioned in this file via "version"; no versioned filenames.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version this item conforms to. Anchors cross-repo schema alignment.

name.description: Unique item name, kebab-case. Matches the items/<name>/ folder.

category.description: Index grouping used by the agent index and docs.

description.description: One-line summary for the agent index; readable without opening any other file.

behavior.description: Behavior model. kind: none (static markup), css-only (state via native inputs and CSS), js-inline (ships a dependency-free script file), zag (behavior runs on @zag-js/* machines behind a thin vanilla binding; the only allowed runtime packages). contract: data-attribute behavior contract strings framework renderers consume. packages: npm names the behavior needs with exact versions for zag; empty for css-only, none, and js-inline.

props.description: Codegen props surface. Items with a variant table surface exactly one enum prop named variant whose values are the closed table; items without variants have no variant prop. HTML-attribute passthrough is rest-props and not declared here.

type.description: enum: closed string union in values. boolean: on/off attr or flag. string: free-form text.

values.description: Closed value list for enum props, in manifest order.

default.description: Default value; string for enum and string props, boolean for boolean props.

slots.description: Named render positions, mapping [data-uifa-slot] hooks to slot names. The root/children default slot is implicit and not listed.

adapters.description: Optional framework-adapter support map. Only declared adapters get generated output.

react.description: A React adapter is generated at adapters/react/<name>.jsx.

cssVars.description: Semantic token roles this item's CSS reads. The kit token vocabulary is the union of cssVars across items plus the base scale declared by themes/index.mjs.

variants.description: Closed [data-uifa-variant] table. Empty when the item has no variants.

default.description: Exactly one variant may set this when the table has a default.

files.description: Paths relative to the item folder.

docs.description: Usage guidance: when to reach for the item, data attributes, token roles.

source.description: Upstream provenance when an item ports third-party work; null for original items.
